name: Runner Extras - Query FlowField Column
brief: Issue #2300: a Query selecting a FlowField column threw NullReferenceException in NCLMetaTable.SqlTableName while BC built the FlowField sub-dataitem, before any row was read.
description: BC turns every FlowField column of a query into an OUTER APPLY sub-dataitem (NCLMetaQuery.CreateSubQueryForFlowFieldCalculation) whose name is derived from NCLMetaTable.SqlTableName; the skeleton NavSqlDatabaseProperties had no InvalidIdentifierChars, so the name computation NRE'd. Once the metadata builds, the runner has no SQL to run the sub-query on, so both query executors now recognise the sub-dataitem (SourceFlowField != null), leave it out of dataitem counting and join execution, and compute its column per owning-dataitem row through FlowFieldPatches -- the same engine CalcFields uses. This suite proves: a local sum(...) FlowField column on a single dataitem (value and the zero-source-rows case), a Base Application FlowField column ("Item Ledger Entry"."Cost Amount (Actual)"), the same FlowField on a joined dataitem, the originally reported join + Method = Sum + FlowField shape grouping per Item Ledger Entry, and a SetRange on a FlowField column evaluated against the calculated value. The oracle values for the first four were measured on a real BC 28.4 service tier in the issue; the plain-BC claims belong upstream in the corpus.
